This application coming on for HEARING this day, th e c  the following:
 ORDER IA No. 19529/2023, an application under Section 301(2) Cr.P.C. is taken up, considered and allowed for the reasons mentioned therein.
Shri D.R. Sharma - learned counsel for the complainant and his associates are permitted to assist the prosecution.

This first bail application has been filed by applicant under section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of bail in connection with Crime No.378/2023 registered at Police Station University, District Gwalior for offence punishable under Sections 376, 377, 506 and 34 of the IPC.
The applicant is in judicial custody since 06/10/2023.

sentences.text: As per the case of prosecution, prosecutrix submitted a written complaint on 24/09/2023 inter alia alleging that she married to accused Ankit Tiwari on 31/05/2022.
After sometime of marriage, she stayed at her matrimonial home in Vaishali Gaziabaad.
Thereafter, she left for Hyderabad with her husband.
In January, 2023, her husband was transferred to Delhi, therefore, she started living in her matrimonial home.
On 25/03/2023, she alongwith her husband and in laws had come to Gwalior.
On that day, when she was changing her clothes, her father in law pushed her on bed and her mother in law gagged her mouth.
Meanwhile, her husband entered into the room and asked the mother to leave.
Thereafter, her father in law committed rape on her and her husband committed sexual assault against the nature.
Thereafter, all the three accused threatened to kill her, if she informs anybody.
She got frightened.
In order to save her marriage, she did not narrate the incident to anybody.
Now, she is reporting this incident.

On such allegations, Police Station University, District Gwalior registered FIR in Crime No.
378/2023 for the offence punishable under Sections 376, 377, 506 and 34 of the IPC.
Statement of prosecutrix was recorded under Section 161 and 164 of the Cr.P.C.
Statement of other witnesses have been recorded. Applicant- Prahalad Tiwari
was arrested on 06/10/2023, he is in custody ever since.
Son of the applicant -Ankit Tiwari was arrested on 06/07/2023.
He was granted bail by the Trial Court.
Wife of the applicant -Anita Tiwari was extended benefit of anticipatory bail by the Trial Court.
Investigation is almost complete.
DNA report is awaited.
Learned Counsel for the applicant, in addition to the grounds mentioned in the application, submits that the applicant has falsely been implicated in the matter.

Matrimonial dispute between husband and wife is given colour of criminal prosecution and in order to create pressure on husband Ankit Tiwari, his father- present applicant was got involved in the present matter, on such false charges.
Ankit Tiwari has submitted a written complaint before Commissioner of Police, Gaziabaad on 28/08/2022 with regard to matrimonial dispute.
Thereafter, this complaint was filed with the delay of around 4 months after pre-meditation and consultation.
Learned counsel for the applicant further submits that applicant is aged 65 years.
He is a builder by profession.
There is no likelihood of absconding leaving behind his family and business.
There is no likelihood of tampering with the evidence.
Jail incarceration is causing hardship to applicant.
The trial would take time to complete.
Therefore, applicant may be extended the benefit of bail.
P e r contra, learned Counsel for the State ably assisted by learned counsel for the complainant opposes the bail application on the ground of gravity of alleged offence.

Learned counsel further submits that prosecutrix was compelled to live with accused despite sexual assault in order to save her marriage and because of which she could report the matter in shape of instant FIR only after a delay of four months.
Considering the gravity of offence, applicant may not be granted bail.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
Considering the arguments advanced by both the parties and overall circumstances of the case but without commenting on merits of the case, this Court is inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Thus, the application is allowed.
